title: VORL-EXPLORE: A Hybrid Learning Planning Approach to Multi-Robot Exploration in Dynamic Environments
abstract: arXiv:2603.07973v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Hierarchical multi-robot exploration decouples frontier allocation from local navigation, making systems brittle in dynamic environments. Without awareness of execution difficulty, allocators may send robots toward frontiers whose routes are congested or unsafe, causing bottlenecks, oscillatory replanning, and redundant coverage. We propose VORL-EXPLORE, a hybrid learning and planning framework that makes exploration execution-aware through execution fidelity, an estimate of local navigability and execution reliability. This fidelity score is used to penalize risky or crowded frontiers in a fidelity-coupled Voronoi allocation objective with inter-robot repulsion, and to arbitrate between global $A^*$ guidance and a reactive reinforcement learning policy during navigation. As a result, robots follow efficient global plans in reliable regions and rely more on safer local reactions in crowded or changing areas. The fidelity model

translated_title: VORL-EXPLORE：一种面向动态环境多机器人探索的混合学习规划方法
translated_abstract: 分层式多机器人探索将边界分配与局部导航解耦，导致系统在动态环境中表现脆弱。由于缺乏对执行难度的感知，分配器可能将机器人派往路线拥堵或不安全的边界，从而造成瓶颈、反复震荡的重规划以及冗余覆盖。我们提出 VORL-EXPLORE，这是一个混合学习与规划框架，通过“执行保真度”——对局部可通行性与执行可靠性的估计——使探索具备执行感知能力。该保真度分数一方面用于在带有机器人间排斥项的保真度耦合 Voronoi 分配目标中惩罚有风险或拥挤的边界，另一方面用于在导航过程中对全局 A* 引导与反应式强化学习策略进行仲裁。由此，机器人在可靠区域遵循高效的全局规划，而在拥挤或不断变化的区域则更多依赖更安全的局部反应。
tldr: 提出VORL-EXPLORE混合学习规划框架，通过“执行保真度”评估局部可通行性与执行可靠性，并将其耦合进Voronoi边界分配目标与全局A*规划、反应式强化学习导航的仲裁中，显著提升动态环境下多机器人探索的鲁棒性和效率。
en_tdlr: VORL-EXPLORE is a hybrid learning-planning framework that makes multi-robot exploration execution-aware via an execution fidelity estimate of local navigability and reliability, coupling frontier allocation and arbitrating between global A* guidance and reactive RL navigation for robust exploration in dynamic environments.
